label: Bible Study
prompt: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are _____, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verse: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
note: Raised with Christ? Then look up — that's where he's seated.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD _____ thee.
verse: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
note: Boaz greets his reapers with a blessing and they bless him right back — the friendliest field in the Bible.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he looked, and, behold, there was a _____ baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verse: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
note: An angel served the burned-out prophet a cake baked on hot coals and a jar of water — then let him nap again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was _____ on both his feet.
verse: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
note: David kept his vow to Jonathan by seating Jonathan's lame son at the royal table for life.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Keeping mercy for thousands, _____ iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verse: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
note: Part of God's self-portrait on Sinai: keeping mercy for thousands, 'forgiving' iniquity and transgression and sin.
